subject: How to determine radioButton choices dynamically?

messages.author: 0a76f2b1c1ac21bc
messages.subject: How to determine radioButton choices dynamically?
parts:
Hi all,

I am new to Shiny and just getting started.

I have a dataset I load in server.R and want to use the column names of a matrix from that dataset to be the radioButton choices.

Is there a way to communicate the column names from server.R into ui.R so that I don't have to write them out explicitly in the radioButtons() function call?


I.e. I'm trying to replace the call to c() in this code:

         radioButtons("distr", "Distribution:",
                      c("Normal" = "norm",
                        "Uniform" = "unif",
                        "Log-normal" = "lnorm",
                        "Exponential" = "exp"))

Thanks a bunch!

~Lina

messages.author: 4114912dbf9e2d36
messages.subject: Re: How to determine radioButton choices dynamically?
parts:
I'm new to shiny as well, so I couldn't get it to work with radioButtons, but I did get it to work with selectInput. basically you set choices = NULL, and then update it with updateSelectInput.somewhere in server.R you should have the colnames so there you want a line to update the choices

updateSelectInput(session, "YourSelectInputID", choices = ColumnNames)

make sure to include session in:
shinyServer(function(input, output, session) {
   #your code here

}
